verdict.rationale: First-party docs show Copilot Chat runs inside VS Code, JetBrains, and Visual Studio. In the editor it explains concepts, proposes edits, and draws extra context from repositories and MCP servers. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of in-IDE chat; chat is limited to three IDEs (not Neovim, though Copilot supports it); documentation of how editor/workspace context is used in chat answers is thin.

support.subject: As a developer, I can chat with the coding assistant directly inside my IDE for contextual help

citations.quote: chat functionality is currently available only in Visual Studio Code, JetBrains, and Visual Studio
